description: Read-only OBD-II scanner (USB/Wi-Fi/BLE) and capability profiler for JP226 car apps

store.summary: Read-only OBD-II scanner for USB, Wi-Fi and BLE with Logger & EV Sound fit
store.description: Connects to ELM327/STN OBD-II adapters over USB serial, Wi-Fi TCP, or Bluetooth LE to scan supported Mode 01 PIDs, Mode 03/07 DTCs, Mode 09 VIN/ECU info, UDS Mode 22 modules/DIDs, and live polling rates. Evaluates and exports compatibility profiles for JP226-GPS-IMU-Logger and the EV Sound Emulator on Cardputer Zero and ADV.
